description: This file is a build script related to runtime post-processing tasks such as copying assets, creating runtime alias files, and orchestrating build steps for a plugin extension system. It handles static asset management and some build-time configuration for runtime environment setup.

methods.name: listStaticExtensionAssetOutputs
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of destination paths for static extension assets, with normalization of path separators.

methods.name: copyStaticExtensionAssets
methods.description: Copies static extension assets from source to destination paths, creating directories as needed, and warns if an asset is missing.

methods.name: writeStableRootRuntimeAliases
methods.description: Creates alias files in the dist directory for runtime scripts matching a specific filename pattern.

methods.name: runRuntimePostBuild
methods.description: Orchestrates the post-build process by invoking functions to copy metadata, dependencies, catalog, generate aliases, and copy static assets.
